review.shorterRoute: Native coprime modular reduction proves the actual subgroup join. Original modular-ratio germs transfer hypothetical adjacent-j membership to analytic invariance. Native cusp bounds and level-one polynomial classification, Laurent uniqueness and the positive-coefficient obstruction prove nonmembership. Reusing the rational prime-step theorem and actual alpha degree gives original simple-extension generation. The exact modular polynomial and reverse root feed the existing embedding constructor; preimage/map field closure proves preservation. Its square fixes j, so the already finite original j-extension gives surjectivity, without claiming involutivity. Native tensor coefficient extension and distinct Laurent conjugates then give all p+1 embeddings and the exact norm product. This avoids a general new modular-curve generator, scheme or Jacobian development. No proof limits, root pins or mathematical scope changed.
assumptionsToDischarge: For every nonzero M and prime p coprime to M, the original Gamma1 field excludes j(q^p), over both complex and rational coefficients.
The original correspondence field is exactly the original lower field with j(q^p) adjoined, of degree p+1; the exact modular polynomial and reverse adjacent root are derived.
An actual original-field reverse automorphism exists with the full forward Hecke equation and reverse j-coordinate equation, over rational and algebraic coefficient fields.

The p twists and final q-expansion form the complete original embedding census; the actual norm is their literal Laurent product, with no assumed generator, embedding-completeness or norm-product premise.
review.remaining: The norm product retains the constructed reverse automorphism. Its value on general beta inputs must still be identified with the exact original diamond action; no involution or Gamma0 reverse formula is claimed. The resulting diamond-correct norm reduction, residue degree equality, genus preservation, original-to-residue place/Picard specialization and torsion injectivity remain. Consequently original geometric Tate Frobenius/inertia, parabolic character realization, exceptional primes, coefficient-field realization, all-weight characteristic-zero association, automorphy and literal higher continuation remain. 16/20; DUB17--20 OPEN.
